claimBoundary: This contract classifies composition semantics; it does not approve any creator, source, content, or public release.
A Flow Map is not an execution Item, completion owner, schedule owner, or parent ICS component.
An ordinary single Flow may use representationMode=flow_only and does not require a Flow Map.

representationModes.definition: One independent Flow with no meaningful parent composition.
Two or more child Flows, or one sensitive Flow whose review wrapper must remain explicit.

mapTypes.definition: The primary source defines a meaningful child-Flow order, phase, D-day progression, day sequence, round, or curriculum sequence.
selectionConditions: Child order is present in the primary source or in an explicit user-authored plan.
Changing child order would change the execution meaning.
Every dependency or order value can be traced to SourceRows or explicit user input.
exclusionConditions: The creator merely listed or curated resources.
The UI display order is the only evidence of sequence.
Items share a category, creator, or date but have no execution dependency.

calendarContract.rule: Only scheduled descendant Items are eligible for Calendar projection.

mapTypes.definition: A creator or curator selected a set of independent source-backed child Flows; selection and attribution matter, but displayed order is not execution dependency.
selectionConditions: The source explicitly presents a curated set.
Each child Flow can be used independently.
The curator identity and each child primary source remain separable.
exclusionConditions: The source defines a required Day, phase, prerequisite, or curriculum order.
Rows from different creators would need to be merged into one Flow spine.
A collection page exists but child source rows were not imported.

calendarContract.rule: Curation membership never creates a schedule or SharedContext.

mapTypes.definition: Child Flows are independent resources or actions with no source-defined execution order.
selectionConditions: Every child Flow remains meaningful when opened or completed first.
The primary value is queueing, choosing, or saving independent child content.
No source row establishes dependencies among child Flows.
exclusionConditions: The source defines a curriculum, Day sequence, phase, or prerequisite.
A curator's selection rationale is the primary value; use source_curation.
A channel or collection lacks imported child rows; use source_import_required instead.

calendarContract.rule: Collection membership never creates a schedule or execution order.

mapTypes.definition: A review wrapper around exactly one sensitive schedule Flow whose dates or applicability require source, locale, freshness, safety, or professional confirmation.
selectionConditions: Exactly one child Flow is in scope.
The source contains a real schedule or age/date window.
Applicability and trust boundaries must remain visible before date resolution or promotion.
exclusionConditions: The candidate is being used to imply a creator-wide portfolio Map.
Required SourceRows or trust anchors are missing.
A date would have to be invented from general knowledge.

calendarContract.rule: Unresolved anchor, locale, freshness, or safety review emits no VEVENT.

properties.title: user-facing title
properties.childFlowIds: unique array of stable Flow IDs

legacyMapping.review: human_or_rule_review_required; absence alone is not evidence

globalInvariants.rule: Every child Flow has exactly one structure-controlling primary source.
SourceRows from different creators are not merged into one Flow spine; a Map may curate separately source-owned child Flows.
Map and Step do not own authoritative Item completion, decision, record, hold, or occurrence state.
Map progress is derived from descendant Item states and cannot be written independently.
A Flow Map is never represented as a date-less parent VEVENT, VTODO, or VJOURNAL.
Source curation and unordered collection cannot gain execution order from display order.
Map membership, creator, category, or curation alone cannot create a SharedContext.
Child Flow and Item IDs remain stable across Map projection and reordering.

validatorRules: mapType must be one of the four canonical map type IDs
childFlowIds must be unique and resolve to existing Flows
ordered_life_event_map requires source-defined order evidence for every ordered child
source_curation and unordered_collection forbid execution dependencies
single_sensitive_schedule requires exactly one child Flow and a complete sensitiveReview object
no map record may contain authoritative schedule or completion state
no Calendar projection may use a Map as its event owner
each child Flow must retain its primary source and attribution references
